questions.title: Minimum jumps
questions.text:
From index 0 you may jump forward at most a[i] steps from index i. Print the minimum number of jumps to reach the last index, or −1 if it cannot be reached.

Input: first line n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5); second line n integers (0 to 10^5).
Output: the minimum jumps or -1.

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
# write your code here
starterCode.javascript:
const data = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/);
// write your code here

questions.explanation: Reference approach: see the standard technique for ‘Minimum jumps’.

questions.title: Paths in a grid with blocks
questions.text:
Count the paths from the top-left to the bottom-right of an r × c grid moving only right or down, avoiding blocked cells (#). Print the count modulo 1 000 000 007.

Input: first line r and c (1 ≤ r, c ≤ 500); then r lines of c characters (. or #).
Output: the number of paths mod 10^9+7.
